newsitem.title: USA: Snow halts fall harvest and tillage in Nebraska.
newsitem.headline: Snow halts fall harvest and tillage in Nebraska.

text.p: Fall harvest and tillage operations in Nebraska were slowed or halted due to snow and icy conditions during the week ended Sunday, according to the latest crop report from the state's Agricultural Statistics Service.
Corn was 95 percent harvested. That figure compared with 98 percent last year and the five-year average of 92 percent.
Sorghum grain harvest was 94 percent complete, behind 100 percent last year and the average pace of 97 percent, the report said.
The winter wheat crop was rated 71 percent good to excellent, 27 percent fair and 2 percent poor.
Topsoil moisture was rated zero percent very short, seven percent short, 72 percent adequate and 21 percent surplus.
This report will be the last weekly crop report until the next growing season begins, the agency said.
